Student based in Riyadh

Muhammad Subhan

I’m an A Level student in Riyadh preparing to study law. Aviation got me interested in how teams make decisions, and that curiosity now runs through my work in technology, negotiation and writing.

About meExplore the portfolio

Background

From aviation to commercial law.

Aviation was one of my first interests. Independent courses in crew management and aircraft design gave me a closer look at how people coordinate, communicate and make decisions under pressure.

That led me towards business and commercial law. I’m particularly curious about what happens when companies buy, sell or invest in a business, and how they decide who takes on the risk.

Writing

The Eleventh Rehearsal

Psychological thriller · In progress

I’m an avid reader and I write fiction. This novel lets me explore how much of what we remember comes from stories we’ve heard over and over.

The voice on the tape is his. So why does the story sound rehearsed?

Daniel Vane edits sound for a living. Seventeen years after his mother vanished, a file from Bellwether arrives with a recording in his own voice and an appointment he never agreed to.
